blocks.content: In this section, you'll learn how to assign a ranking to each row based on specific criteria using SQL window functions. These functions allow comparisons without modifying the original data structure.
We will cover three key ranking functions:

items: ROW_NUMBER(): Assigns a unique number to each row, even if values are the same.
RANK(): Assigns the same rank to tied values but skips numbers.
DENSE_RANK(): Similar to RANK(), but without gaps in rankings.

blocks.content: Let's start with the ROW_NUMBER() function.
